one_variable: native value/position tie cutoff for source block pruning
proof: 2047 seeded ordinary winners lower-bound the global ordinary cutoff in the native BF16-key/earlier-position total order; only clusters with an equal upper key and first block after the seeded cutoff can be removed; always restore the global mandatory last cluster
invalid_seed: short/padded/nonfinite seed gives key zero and a maximum cutoff position, disabling tie pruning
gates: all source winners and ordered handoff blocks/counts
